name: moneymind-ai
description: Personal finance companion powered by MoneyMind AI
author: MoneyMind AI

scripts.app:dev: npm run native:build && concurrently -k "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload" "vite --host localhost" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:8000/health http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.copy:installer: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='release/MoneyMind-AI-Setup-0.1.0.exe';const dest='public/downloads/MoneyMind-AI-Setup-0.1.0.exe';if(!fs.existsSync(src)){console.error('Installer not found: '+src);process.exit(1)}fs.mkdirSync('public/downloads',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);console.log('Installer copied to '+dest)"
scripts.dist:win: npm run native:build && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis && npm run copy:installer
scripts.dist:win:dir: npm run native:build && npm run build && electron-builder --win dir
